Forged for the frontline — this Five Finger Death Punch hoodie channels the raw, military-grade energy that defines FFDP. Featuring bold dark artwork inspired by the band's iconic warrior aesthetic, this gothic pullover is built for metalheads who live loud and hit hard.

Crafted from premium heavyweight fleece for a comfortable yet durable fit, this hoodie is your armor for cold nights, concerts, and everyday rebellion. The design pays homage to the aggressive spirit of American heavy metal — from the mosh pit to the streets.

Perfect as a heavy metal gift for fans of Five Finger Death Punch, this metalhead hoodie pairs effortlessly with dark denim, combat boots, and an attitude that refuses to kneel. Whether you're repping at a show or making a statement on the daily, this pullover says everything without saying a word.

Unisex fit. Multiple sizes available. Designed and printed in the USA. Not for everyone — only for those who understand that real metal is a lifestyle, not a playlist.
